description: MODIS Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. Data from this site were used in the case study, Catalyzing Investment and Building Capacity in Las Cruces. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
